grader.method: Read all seven final6 answers and citations, compared them with critical-bhyt-7.jsonl and local source material, checked quote/span/hash/provenance and citation-to-retrieved-evidence linkage, and marked unavailable proof as NOT_OBSERVABLE. No runtime, database, or source-file mutation.

evidence_integrity.warning: All citations exactly link to retrieved evidence by document/span/hash, but 29 citations explicitly report provenance_verified=false and only 17 emitted-quote hashes equal their reported text_sha256. Field presence is not canonical-source proof.

source_check.note: Public document numbers are used for authority matching only. Opaque database/chunk IDs are excluded from grading.
